state_file.label: State file
state_file.description: Path to the file zhj feierabend's countdown writes the remaining seconds to.

poll_interval.label: Poll interval (s)
poll_interval.description: How often to re-read the state file while the widget is visible.

text_template.label: Text template
text_template.description: Shown while the countdown is armed. {seconds} is replaced with the remaining seconds.

text_color.label: Text color
text_color.description: A Noctalia color role (e.g. error, primary) or a hex color.
